name: DeepSeek V4 Pro
short: DeepSeek's 1.6T/49B MIT open-weights flagship MoE (1M context, 384K out) for reasoning/software engineering; SWE-bench 96.4% and GPQA 92.8%.
standout: MIT open-weights flagship whose software-engineering and math reasoning rivals closed frontier models while remaining self-hostable for free.
tradeoff: The rate card swings with peak/off-peak windows and self-hosting demands a very large MoE footprint — real cost depends heavily on when and how you run it.
